name: distribution-solution
body: Distribution solution: the release pipeline and package channels are repo/CI artefacts (GitHub Actions YAML, a Ruby formula, a Scoop JSON manifest, docs), not Go code, so they will have no scanner code FQNs. Their implemented-by edges are therefore not authored. The plan should give them target-less tasks, or planned nodes if the scanner covers those files. Push/tag rule (global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag): the release workflow may push only manifest-only commits (version/URL/checksum updates under `Formula/` and `bucket/`); it never pushes code and never creates tags. Humans push all code and create all tags; agents never push or tag.
